newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May-July temperatures, rainfall seen normal.
newsitem.headline: Japan May-July temperatures, rainfall seen normal.

text.p: Average temperatures and rainfall in Japan from May to July are forecast to be normal for the time of year, the Meteorological Agency said in its three-month weather report on Monday.
Many fair days can be expected throughout Japan in May, excluding the southernmost Ryukyu islands which are likely to see many cloudy and rainy days, the agency said.
June is expected to be mostly cloudy and rainy, as is usual for the period.
Temperatures and rainfall are expected to be mostly normal, however precipitation in coastal areas along the Pacific in eastern and western Japan is forecast to be lower than average.
The rainy weather is forecast to continue into July, which is expected to see normal temperatures, the agency said.
In mainland Japan, the rainy season usually begins in early June and lasts until the end of July.
